title: Which Allowance Lots Are Counted toward the Pot a Ticket May Draw On
content:
What counts as the allowance an Employee Meal Account has to draw on turns on how often its plan grants allowance and how quickly its lots lapse.

**Clause.** Where the plan grants allowance on a daily basis and its lots lapse within two days, the lots counted are those granted in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked. Where the plan grants allowance on a monthly basis or its lots lapse after more than two days, the lots counted are those granted in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked. Where neither holds, the unspent allowance figure the account carries is taken as it stands.

## The plan figures this reads

| Meal plan | Allowance granted | A lot stays spendable for |
|---|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | none | 0 calendar days |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | none | 0 calendar days |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | none | 0 calendar days |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | each service day | 1 calendar day |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | each service day | 1 calendar day |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | each calendar month | 30 calendar days |

## The three readings

| Plan's grant basis | How long a lot stays spendable | Lots counted |
|---|---|---|
| Each service day | 2 calendar days or fewer | Lots granted in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked |
| Each calendar month | Any | Lots granted in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked |
| Any basis | More than 2 calendar days | Lots granted in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked |
| Any other combination | Any | The unspent allowance figure the account carries, as it stands |

A lot lapsing in exactly 2 calendar days lapses within two days and so falls in the first case; one lapsing in 3 falls in the second.

*Hypothetical illustration.* On a plan granting allowance each service day with lots lapsing after 1 calendar day, the lots counted are those granted in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked — say $180.00 of grants. On a plan granting allowance each calendar month with lots lapsing after 30 calendar days, the lots counted are those granted in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked.
